blocks.text: The inner Self is the stage.
blocks.directed: The inner Self is the stage.

blocks.text: The Stage Is Your Inner Self. The Universe Has Gone Full Broadway.
blocks.directed: The Stage Is Your Inner Self. The Universe Has Gone Full Broadway.

blocks.text: But where does the performance occur?
blocks.directed: But where does the performance occur?

blocks.text: Now this needs careful interpretation, because it would be tempting to say:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Now this needs careful interpretation, because it would be tempting to say:

blocks.text: But Kṣemarāja’s explanation is more specific.
blocks.directed: But Kṣemarāja’s explanation is more specific.

blocks.text: Here antarātman refers to the inner individual constitution — particularly the subtle and causal dimensions of embodied experience.
blocks.directed: Here antarātman refers to the inner individual constitution — particularly the subtle and causal dimensions of embodied experience.

blocks.text: This isn’t simply another name for supreme consciousness.
blocks.directed: This isn’t simply another name for supreme consciousness.

blocks.text: The eightfold subtle constitution comprising the mental faculties and subtle sensory principles.
blocks.directed: The eightfold subtle constitution comprising the mental faculties and subtle sensory principles.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja connects the stage with this subtle embodiment.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja connects the stage with this subtle embodiment.

blocks.text: He also mentions the causal condition associated with voidness and vital energy.
blocks.directed: He also mentions the causal condition associated with voidness and vital energy.

blocks.text: In other words, the stage is the inner structure through which the individual performance becomes possible.
blocks.directed: In other words, the stage is the inner structure through which the individual performance becomes possible.

blocks.text: Think about how you experience the world.
blocks.directed: Think about how you experience the world.

blocks.text: You’re not merely receiving a sequence of completely uninterpreted objects.
blocks.directed: You’re not merely receiving a sequence of completely uninterpreted objects.

blocks.text: And the entire inner apparatus participates in the construction of your lived world.
blocks.directed: And the entire inner apparatus participates in the construction of your lived world.

blocks.text: Now Kṣemarāja isn’t proposing a modern neuroscientific theory.
blocks.directed: Now Kṣemarāja isn’t proposing a modern neuroscientific theory.

blocks.text: He’s describing a tantric metaphysical structure.
blocks.directed: He’s describing a tantric metaphysical structure.

blocks.text: But the theatrical metaphor becomes extraordinarily illuminating.
blocks.directed: But the theatrical metaphor becomes extraordinarily illuminating.

blocks.text: The actor manifests different roles through the stage of the inner being.
blocks.directed: The actor manifests different roles through the stage of the inner being.

blocks.text: And the subtle body provides the conditions through which those roles are enacted.
blocks.directed: And the subtle body provides the conditions through which those roles are enacted.

blocks.text: You construct a particular identity in relation to them.
blocks.directed: You construct a particular identity in relation to them.

blocks.text: All of this belongs to the inner apparatus through which experience unfolds.
blocks.directed: All of this belongs to the inner apparatus through which experience unfolds.

blocks.text: The same individual may appear in a completely different setting.
blocks.directed: The same individual may appear in a completely different setting.

blocks.text: Yet the experience arises through the powers of consciousness operating in a different condition.
blocks.directed: Yet the experience arises through the powers of consciousness operating in a different condition.

blocks.text: The stage has changed its scenery.
blocks.directed: The stage has changed its scenery.

blocks.text: The ordinary person becomes absorbed in the stage and the roles.
blocks.directed: The ordinary person becomes absorbed in the stage and the roles.

blocks.text: The realised yogi recognises their underlying nature.
blocks.directed: The realised yogi recognises their underlying nature.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja explains that the actor manifests the world’s drama through the successive activities of the inner senses, while the subtle body constitutes the stage upon which the performance unfolds. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja explains that the actor manifests the world’s drama through the successive activities of the inner senses, while the subtle body constitutes the stage upon which the performance unfolds. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: This also explains why the inner faculties aren’t simply enemies to be destroyed.
blocks.directed: This also explains why the inner faculties aren’t simply enemies to be destroyed.

blocks.text: And within Āṇavopāya, they can become instruments of recognition.
blocks.directed: And within Āṇavopāya, they can become instruments of recognition.

blocks.text: The individual starts from the stage.
blocks.directed: The individual starts from the stage.

blocks.text: And through their contemplation, moves towards recognition of the actor.
blocks.directed: And through their contemplation, moves towards recognition of the actor.

blocks.text: Now, think of the relationship between these last two sūtras.
blocks.directed: Now, think of the relationship between these last two sūtras.

blocks.text: The inner self is the stage.
blocks.directed: The inner self is the stage.

blocks.text: The stage provides the locus of the drama.
blocks.directed: The stage provides the locus of the drama.

blocks.text: And now all we need is an audience.
blocks.directed: And now all we need is an audience.

blocks.text: But because this is Kashmir Śaivism, the audience is going to be something completely unexpected.
blocks.directed: But because this is Kashmir Śaivism, the audience is going to be something completely unexpected.
